name: Tim Sheehy
bio: Timothy Patrick Sheehy is an American politician serving since 2025 as the junior United States senator from Montana. A member of the Republican Party, he is the youngest Republican U.S. senator and the second-youngest U.S. senator, after Jon Ossoff.
